Hi Priya / Partner Ops team,

Following up on our earlier threads — we'd like to set a recurring 30-min cadence for joint pipeline reviews for the CloudWave Analytics account and any other mid-market opportunities where GCP co-sell can help accelerate procurement. High-level asks:

- Brief pipeline review of top 6 opportunities (status, next step, blockers)
- Confirm GCP engagement (ASE/PM/Partner PM) and introduce any missing stakeholders
- Discuss co-sell materials (one-pager, benefit metrics, pricing guidance) and next steps for reps

I've attached a pipeline export (CloudWave-focused) and the intake form for any deals you want added to the co-sell queue. First pass availability: Wed 6/2 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 6/3 14:00-14:30 PT.

Can you confirm availability and owners? Also tagging Marissa and Camila from our side to ensure enablement and renewal context are included.

Thanks,
